import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', hue='Gender', style='BMI Category', s=100, alpha=0.7)

# Add titles and labels
scatter_plot.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by Gender and BMI Category', fontsize=16)
scatter_plot.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (Hours)', fontsize=14)
scatter_plot.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (Scale 1-10)', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Gender and BMI Category', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
